explanation: In February 2019 P.V. Sindhu signed a four-year deal of about ₹50 crore with Chinese brand Li Ning – then the biggest for an Indian non-cricketer; her earlier Yonex contract had ended.

exam: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II Screening Test 2017
q: Who is the winner of Australian Grand Prix, 2017?
explanation: Sebastian Vettel (Ferrari) won the 2017 Australian Grand Prix in Melbourne, ahead of Lewis Hamilton (2nd) and Valtteri Bottas (3rd).

q: Who won the Italian Grand Prix, 2017 formula 1 car racing?
explanation: Lewis Hamilton (Mercedes) won the 2017 Italian Grand Prix at Monza, ahead of team-mate Valtteri Bottas and Sebastian Vettel.

exam: APPSC Technical Assistant (Geo Physics) & Technical Assistan
q: Who won the World Champion title at the Hockey Junior World Cup at Lucknow, in December, 2016?
explanation: India won the Hockey Junior World Cup at Lucknow in December 2016, beating Belgium 2–1 in the final – their second junior title after 2001.
